title: Keyboard Piano-ist
description:
Play Piano and learn typing at the same time! Discover your inner piano talent.



Improve your hand-eye coordination and reaction speed.

Get better at concentrating and muscle memory retention.

Train your fingers and get better at typing by improving speed and accuracy.



Education and Entertainment, Edu-tainment, is way more fun and efficient for learning!



If you are using a Razer Chroma compatible keyboard, the keyboard keys would light up accordingly to the notes!

Play the game, learn the piano!
